answer: Each identity holds a private state refreshed by an unpredictable micro-challenge keyed to its record. Clones never receive the same prompt, and each reply is due inside a narrow window. An operator can script a thousand signups but cannot answer a thousand divergent prompts without a thousand separate workers. One missed window zeroes the weight until a proving run revives it. Farms end up buying attention, not storage, spread across the canyon between a script and many hands. A violet bar beside each name grows with windows met: a mirror of context, copyable in shape, never in substance.
